about_the_game:
Three heroes. One stolen artifact. A journey through steel and secrets, with something ancient stirring beneath it all.

Danger World is a handcrafted, turn-based RPG that blends classic adventure vibes with snappy combat and a story full of choices.

FOLLOW THREE ADVENTURERS ON A HIGH-STAKES QUEST

When their town’s sacred jewel vanishes, Belle, Amelia, and Wren set out to track the thieves and stumble upon more than they bargained for. From sunlit forests to smoking foundries, they’ll battle corrupted machines and unravel long-buried mysteries.

FIGHT SMART, STRIKE HARD

Combat in Danger World is turn-based and built for momentum. Every hero has a distinct style and role:

  • Belle takes the hits and brings down the hammer.

  • Amelia darts in with blades and finishes what others start.

  • Wren hits wide and hard with his greatsword.

No skill trees. No stat juggling. Just tight, purposeful encounters where your timing and decisions matter.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

From riverside towns to ancient ruins, every stop on your journey brings choices and consequences. Do you help the villagers or keep chasing the trail? Do you explore the detour or press forward toward the threat?

Your route changes how the story unfolds and what you bring to the final battle.

EXPLORE A WORLD ON THE EDGE

A dark army is tearing through the land, awakening forces meant to stay buried. Your trio might be the last defense against what’s coming, but only if you can stay ahead of it.

NO GRIND. JUST ADVENTURE.

Each battle is crafted, not random. Each move pushes the story forward. You’ll face enemies that hit hard, force choices, and don’t waste your time.

TAKE THE ROAD LESS TRAVELED

Choose your own path through Danger World. Routes branch, choices ripple, and who you save (or don’t) might echo later.

This is Danger World.

short_description: Danger World is a 2D narrative game with strategic turn-based combat. Join our spunky adventurers as they hack, slash, and smash their way through waves of enemies. Meet colorful characters, confront Lady Darkwood's army, and reclaim the stolen artifact.
